dialog_history.content: Where exactly is the swelling (e.g., face/lips/eyelids/neck/throat vs one arm/leg vs generalized), and did it start suddenly (minutes–hours) or gradually (days)?
It’s in my legs—both ankles, the left top of the foot, the left thigh, and the right sole. It didn’t start suddenly; it feels more gradual over days rather than minutes to hours.
Do you also have any shortness of breath, chest pain/pressure, or new cough (especially when lying flat), and have you noticed swelling in your face/eyelids or any hives/itching?
I don’t have shortness of breath, chest pain/pressure, or a new cough, and I haven’t noticed swelling in my face or eyelids. I also don’t have hives or itching.
Have you had any fever, recent infection (like a sore throat/cough), or any pain/redness/warmth in either leg (especially where it’s swollen), and is the swelling worse on one side than the other?

I don’t have a fever or a recent infection like a sore throat or cough. I do have pain in the swollen areas, but I’m not sure about warmth or redness. It seems worse on the left side overall (left ankle/left top of the foot/left thigh) than on the right (right sole/ankle).

Is the leg swelling mainly on one side (left) with any calf tenderness or pain when you walk, and have you noticed any redness/warmth in that left leg or any recent long travel, surgery, injury, or being immobile?

Yes, it’s mainly on the left side—left ankle, left top of the foot, and left thigh. I have pain when I walk, but I’m not sure if there’s calf tenderness specifically. I haven’t had any recent long travel, recent surgery, injury, or been immobile.

Have you had any recent new medications (especially an ACE inhibitor like lisinopril), hormone therapy/testosterone, or known blood-clot risk factors (prior DVT/PE, family history of clots, smoking), and do you have any shortness of breath when walking or lying flat?

I can’t recall any new medications like an ACE inhibitor, hormone therapy, or testosterone. I don’t know of any prior DVT/PE, and I don’t know family history of clots. I don’t have shortness of breath when walking or lying flat.
Do you have any redness or warmth over the swollen left thigh/ankle/foot, and does pressing the swollen area leave a dent (pitting) or does it feel firm/non-pitting?
I’m not sure about redness or warmth over the left thigh/ankle/foot. When I press, it doesn’t feel like it leaves a dent—I think it’s more firm/non-pitting.
When you press on the swollen areas, does it feel firm and non-pitting as you said, and is the swelling tender to touch specifically (yes/no), especially over the left thigh or calf?
Yes, when I press it feels firm and non-pitting. And it is tender to touch, especially over the left thigh/calf area.
Do you have any calf pain or tenderness specifically on the left (for example, pain when you press the calf), and does it worsen when you flex your ankle/toes or when you walk?
I do have calf pain/tenderness on the left, and it seems worse when I walk. I’m not sure about whether it gets worse when I flex my ankle/toes.
Do you have any recent long-distance travel (car/plane), prolonged bed rest/immobility, recent hospitalization, or any leg injury/surgery in the past 4–6 weeks?
No—no recent long-distance travel, no prolonged bed rest or immobility, no recent hospitalization, and no leg injury or surgery in the past 4–6 weeks.

Do you have any skin changes over the left leg (redness, warmth, or a visible difference in color compared with the right), and have you noticed any open sores, insect bites, or a recent cut/injury on that leg?
I haven’t noticed any open sores, insect bites, or a recent cut/injury. I’m not sure about redness or warmth or a color difference compared to the right.
Do you have any fever or chills, and have you noticed any new shortness of breath or chest pain at any time since the swelling started?
I don’t have fever or chills. And I haven’t noticed any new shortness of breath or chest pain since the swelling started.

Do you have any history of heart, kidney, or liver disease (or do you notice reduced urine output, foamy urine, or yellowing of the eyes/skin), and have you had any recent weight gain or swelling that’s worse in the evening?

I have heart failure and a known heart valve issue. I don’t know about kidney or liver disease. I did gain weight recently, and the swelling has been more noticeable over time (not sure about being worse in the evening).

No, I don’t have sore throat or upper-airway symptoms like a runny/stuffy nose, hoarseness, or a muffled voice. It’s mostly the intense coughing fits.

I don’t know of any exposure to someone with a prolonged cough, like whooping cough. I can’t say if it’s worse at night or triggered by activity or cold air—it’s mainly the intense coughing fits.

I’m not sure if he’s fully up to date on his DTaP/Tdap doses, and I don’t know if he received all the scheduled ones.

I don’t know of anyone at home or close contacts having a prolonged cough like **whooping cough/pertussis**. So I can’t say when it would have started before his coughing.
